question: In an isosceles Δ ABC, AC = BC, if each of the two equal angles of Δ ABC is 9 degrees less than two -fifth of the third angle. Find the value of ((2∠C-3∠A+∠B)/(2))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the third angle ∠C be x.

Each equal angle (∠A = ∠B) = (2/5)x − 9°.

Sum of angles: x + 2 × [(2/5)x − 9°] = 180° ⇒ x + (4/5)x − 18° = 180° ⇒ (9/5)x = 198°.

⇒ x = 110° (∠C). ∴ ∠A = ∠B = (2/5 × 110°) − 9° = 44° − 9° = 35°.

Value = (2×110° − 3×35° + 35°) / 2 = (220° − 70°) / 2 = 150° / 2 = 75°.

**∴ The correct answer is 75°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** In Δ ABC, **AC = BC**, which implies ∠A = ∠B (angles opposite to equal sides). Let the third angle be ∠C.

**Formula Used:** Sum of internal angles of a triangle = 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2442be0b070cba989c4e136a973aa41292861ee517de31871f6dfb501e8ee401.png] 

⇒ Let ∠C = x.

⇒ According to the question, ∠A = ∠B = (2/5)x − 9.

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ [(2/5)x − 9] + [(2/5)x − 9] + x = 180°

⇒ (4/5)x − 18 + x = 180°

⇒ (9/5)x = 198°

⇒ x = (198 × 5) / 9 = 22 × 5 = 110°.

⇒ ∴ ∠C = 110°

⇒ ∠A = ∠B = (2/5 × 110) − 9 = 44 − 9 = 35°.

⇒ Required value = ((2∠C − 3∠A + ∠B) / 2)

⇒ Value = (2(110) − 3(35) + 35) / 2

⇒ Value = (220 − 105 + 35) / 2 = 150 / 2 = 75°.

**∴ The correct answer is 75°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Isosceles Triangle Property

In an isosceles triangle, the angles opposite to the equal sides are always equal (∠A = ∠B if AC = BC).

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all three interior angles of any Euclidean triangle is always 180°.</p
